question_title: What will be Donald Trump's approval rating on August 14, 2026?
summary: Trump's approve % (not net) on the Silver Bulletin CSV 'approve' column was 38.97% on July 24, 2026, range-bound at 38.3–40.1% over the prior two months. With a ~21-day horizon to August 14 and a heavily-smoothed, slow-moving series, I ran a Monte Carlo (sigma_21=0.85 + 12% news-shock component + mild reversion to band center 39.2), yielding a center of 39.03, P10=37.86, P90=40.20. The distribution is slightly wider than the observed band to allow for possible news shocks. The question bounds (33.95–46.05) sit far in the tails.
